flow.name: order-route-by-content
flow.doc:description: Content-based router: receives an order on POST /eip/orders/route and sends it to the review, international or domestic handler depending on its amount and destination country.

when.expression: #[(not (payload is Object)) or isEmpty(payload.orderId) or isEmpty(payload.country) or not (payload.amount is Number)]

raise-error.doc:name: Raise BAD_REQUEST Error - Missing order fields
raise-error.description: orderId, country and amount (number) are required

logger.doc:name: INFO: Log routing result
logger.message: #['Order ' ++ payload.orderId ++ ' routed to ' ++ payload.routedTo ++ ', correlationId=' ++ correlationId]

sub-flow.name: sf-route-order-to-review
sub-flow.doc:description: Review handler of the content-based router: accepts an order whose amount is at or above the review threshold for manual review.

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { orderId: payload.orderId, routedTo: "MANUAL_REVIEW", reason: "AMOUNT_AT_OR_ABOVE_THRESHOLD", threshold: p('eip.router.reviewThreshold') as Number }

sub-flow.name: sf-route-order-to-international-fulfilment
sub-flow.doc:description: International handler of the content-based router: accepts an order shipped outside the home country, which needs a customs declaration.

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { orderId: payload.orderId, routedTo: "INTERNATIONAL_FULFILMENT", country: upper(payload.country), customsDeclarationRequired: true }

sub-flow.name: sf-route-order-to-domestic-fulfilment
sub-flow.doc:description: Domestic handler of the content-based router: accepts every valid order that no earlier rule claimed.

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { orderId: payload.orderId, routedTo: "DOMESTIC_FULFILMENT", country: upper(payload.country), customsDeclarationRequired: false }
